entries.title: Luke 8:2
segments: V. 2. Mary Magdalene-Or Mary of Magdala, a town in Galilee: probably the person mentioned in the last chapter.

entries.title: Luke 8:15
segments:
V. 15. Who-keep it-Not like the highway side: 
 
  And bring forth fruit-Not like the thorny ground: 
 
  With perseverance-Not like the stony.

entries.title: Luke 8:16
segments: V. 16. No man having lighted a candle-As if he had said, And let your good fruit appear openly.

entries.title: Luke 8:17
segments: V. 17. For nothing is hid -Strive not to conceal it at all; for you can conceal nothing long.

entries.title: Luke 8:18
segments: V. 18. The word commonly translated seemeth, wherever it occurs, does not weaken, but greatly strengthens the sense.

entries.title: Luke 8:29
segments: V. 29. For many times it had caught him-Therefore our compassionate Lord made the more haste to cast him out.

entries.title: Luke 8:31
segments: V. 31. The abyss-That is, the bottomless pit.

entries.title: Luke 8:32
segments: V. 32. To enter into the swine-Not that they were any easier in the swine than out of them.  Had it been so, they would not so soon have dislodged themselves, by destroying the herd.

entries.title: Luke 8:52
segments: V. 52. She is not dead but sleepeth-Her soul is not separated finally from the body; and this short separation is rather to be called sleep than death.
